numerics.full_score: v7 integer-moment objective with rational lambda=7/20 and eta=1/4; certified square-root intervals
numerics.comparison: mathematical objective rounded half-even to integer micro-units, then ascending canonical string node ID
numerics.bound_pruning: ceil(1e6 * rational outward upper bound) < incumbent integer micro-score; ambiguous/equal values continue evaluation
numerics.ties: complete ambiguous candidates, compare canonical IDs; ranking only affects evaluation order
numerics.legacy: distinct v7 arithmetic, not bitwise NumPy/v6 score replay

methods.rule: double global rank prefix; restart greedy with valid memoization; stop at first identical consecutive ordered solution or full graph
best-upper-bound-first; same topology and SSE bound; canonical tie-break

methods.threshold: max full-greedy degree-rank percentile over development graphs and seeds, separately at each k
methods.dependency: finish all E2 full runs, fit one frozen threshold per k, then run component; E2 component results are in-sample
methods.offline_cost: record required full-greedy label generation and threshold fit; include in single-query cost; amortization only at declared Q=10 or 100

bound.spread_upper_bound: size of directed <=h-hop reachability union for S plus v; includes seed nodes
bound.partial_sse: Q_r - A_r^2/r; exact integer numerator r*Q_r-A_r^2; D_0=0
bound.cache_policy: per-arm cold cache; reuse only identical seed set and world; topology cache capped with deterministic LRU

worlds.derivation: SHA256 of version|graph_hash|probability_hash|seed|family|index, first 63 bits; verify no duplicate IDs
worlds.selection80: first 20 are identical to selection20 in matching case; secondary repeated measure

cost.projection: C_dev=max(1,max completed development decision-time ratio versus full). Sum 1.5*C_dev*(8+L)*T_full for each E3 block and 1.5*C_dev*4*T_full for each E4 block; L=1+ceil(log2(max(1,n/(2*k)))); include separate preparation/evaluation estimates. Projection is a gate, not a guaranteed runtime bound.
cost.unresolved_development_failure: any retained arm timeout, memory or numeric failure blocks a finite projection; resolve or version whole design, preserve failures

statistics.primary: paired cold-accounted total-time ratios check_risk_bound/generic_bound and check_risk_bound/check_mean_bound
statistics.secondary_efficiency: decision-time ratios and work counts; cannot substitute for primary
statistics.correctness_gate: zero ordered trajectory differences for exact arms
statistics.reporting_unit: network x k, five stochastic blocks; no network-population inference
statistics.approximate_quality: paired independent-world delta_J; no equivalence/noninferiority claim
statistics.failures: report all planned blocks; right-censor timeouts; no complete-case speedup headline

gnn.reason: isolate search mechanism before paying for learning
gnn.later_entry_gate: separate declared ranking attribution study with identical mechanism and all training/inference costs
